fn operators(a: u64, b: u64) -> u64
  ! pure
  requires true
  ensures result == 1_000
  ensures result == 'A'
  ensures result == 0x1b
  ensures result == 0b101
  ensures result == (a + b)
  ensures result == (a - b)
  ensures result == (a * b)
  ensures result == (a / b)
  ensures result == (a % b)
  ensures result == (a << b)
  ensures result == (a >> b)
  ensures result == (a & b)
  ensures result == (a | b)
  ensures result == (a ^ b)
  ensures result == (a == b)
  ensures result == (a != b)
  ensures result == (a < b)
  ensures result == (a <= b)
  ensures result == (a > b)
  ensures result == (a >= b)
  ensures result == (true && false)
  ensures result == (true || false)
  ensures result == !true
{
  a
}
